answer: Forging a thousand sock-puppets costs a thousand deposits, slashed on collusion proof—like planting a juniper orchard on barren karst, cheap seeds die, only deep-rooted trees yield. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bonded deposit tied to a verified hardware root, and voting power scales with stake duration, not count. Attackers burn capital faster than they gain influence. In practice, Agent0085 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
